title: Goto
text: Pass block input to From blocks, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Tag visibility} sets Scope of the Goto block tag; {Goto tag} sets the block identifier, {Icon display} sets the text to display on block, {Rename All} sets the propagate name throughout and {Corresponding blocks} sets the blocks connected to this Goto block block. Values come from the instance.
